item.title: Git教程
item.description:
# 1.常用命令 ## 1.1 克隆仓库
```bash git clone <repository_url> ```
## 1.2 查看状态
```bash git status ``` ## 1.3 添加文件到暂存区
```bash git add <file_name> ``` ## 1.4 提交更改
```bash git commit -m 'commit message' ``` ## 1.5 推送到远程仓库
```bash git push origin <branch_name> ``` ## 1.6 拉取远程仓库的更改
```bash git pull origin <branch_name> ``` ## 1.7 创建分支
```bash git branch <branch_name> ``` ## 1.8 切换分支
```bash git checkout <branch_name> ``` ## 1.9 合并分支
```bash git merge <branch_name> ``` ## 1.10 查看提交历史
```bash git log ``` ## 1.11 删除分支
```bash git branch -d <branch_name> ``` ## 1.12 查看远程仓库
```bash git remote -v ``` ## 1.13 添加远程仓库
```bash git remote add <remote_name> <repository_url> ``` ## 1.14 删除远程仓库
```bash git remote remove <remote_name> ``` ## 1.15 查看分支
```bash git branch ``` ## 1.16 查看远程分支
```bash git branch -r ``` ## 1.17 查看所有分支
```bash git branch -a ``` ## 1.18 重命名分支
```bash git branch -m <old_branch_name> <new_branch_name> ```。
